Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:11:1.hebrew: מה יתאונן - מה מועיל אנינות לאדם לסמוך על כך מלהזהר ביצרו? כל זמן שהוא חי, צריך להיות גבר על חטאיו, שאם לא כן — יהא יצרו גובר עליו ויחטיאנו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:11:1.english: Why does [one] complain - Of what avail is [the state of] acute mourning to a person, to rely upon it [and refrain] from guarding against his [evil] inclination? As long as he is alive, he must prevail over his sins, for if not, his inclination will overpower him and cause him to sin.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:11:2.hebrew: מה יתאונן אדם חי - למה יתאונן אדם חי? למה יתרעם אדם על הקורות הבאות עליו, אחר כל החסד שאני עושה עמו, שנתתי לו חיים ולא הבאתי עליו מיתה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:11:2.english: Why does a living man complain - Why should a living person complain? Why should a person complain about the occurrences that befall him, after all the kindness that I perform with him, in that I gave him life and did not bring death upon him?

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:11:3.english: About his circumstances - About the occurrences that befall him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:11:4.hebrew: מה יתאונן אדם חי - למה יתאונן אדם חי? למה יתרעם אדם על הקורות הבאות עליו, אחר כל החסד שאני עושה עמו, שנתתי לו חיים ולא הבאתי עליו מיתה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:11:4.english: Why does a living man complain - Why should a living man complain? Why should a man complain about the occurrences that befall him, after all the kindness that I perform for him, in that I gave him life and did not bring death upon him?

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:11:5.hebrew: וכי גבר על חטאיו הוא - שלא חטא לי, ובצדקתו הוא חי? בתמיה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:11:5.english: Has he overpowered his sins? - [Meaning,] that he did not sin against Me, and lives by his righteousness? [This is said] in astonishment.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:12:1.hebrew: ורבנן - אפילו תביר יצריה כדקאמרת, יש לחוש: פעמים שאין שם אנינות, ועושין עצמן כאילו נושאין תינוק מת ויוצאין לעבירה, כי ההוא עובדא — דהוה עובדא בההיא איתתא, ואפיקתיה לתינוק חי בחזקת מת לעשות עבירה עם ההולך עמה לקוברו. לשון אחר ממורי הזקן: ולא גרסינן "ורבנן", אלא כולה באבא שאול גריס: "דיו חיים שנתתי לו כי ההיא איתתא" — דאמרינן במועד קטן (דף כז:) שקשתה על מתה יותר מדאי, עד שמתו ז' בניה והיא אחריהם, מחמת שנתאוננה על מדותיו. "דהוה עובדא ואפיקתיה" — ל"ג:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:12:1.english: And the Rabbis - Even if his [evil] inclination is broken, as you said, there is cause for concern: sometimes there is no acute mourning there, and they make themselves appear as though they are carrying out a deceased infant and go out to [commit] a transgression, like that incident, where an incident occurred with a certain woman, and she brought out a living infant under the presumption of being dead to commit a transgression with the one who went with her to bury him. Another explanation from my elder teacher: And we do not read "And the Rabbis"; rather, the entire [passage] is read as [part of] Abba Shaul: "The life that I gave him is sufficient for him, like that woman" — as we say in Moed Katan (27b) that she grieved excessively over her deceased [child], until her seven sons died and she [died] after them, because she complained against His ways. [The words] "where an incident occurred and she brought him out" are not read.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:13:1.hebrew: והוציאוה עשרה אנשים במטה - בחזקת שהיא מתה, וקלקלו עמה, ואשת איש היתה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:13:1.english: And ten men carried her out on a bier - Under the presumption that she was dead, and they engaged in illicit relations with her; and she was a married woman.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:13:2.english: That ten join together and steal a beam - Which has in it a load for ten [people].

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:14:1.hebrew: מוסרים לו - בית דין. מי שקנא לאשתו ונסתרה, והוא מעלה להשקותה — מוסרין לו בית דין שבעירו שני תלמידי חכמים, שמא יבא עליה בדרך, שהרי נאסרה עליו, כדתנן (סוטה דף כז:): ״נטמאה נטמאה, אחד לבעל ואחד לבועל״. אם בא עליה — שוב אין המים בודקין אותה, דכתיב (במדבר ה׳:ל״א): ״ונקה האיש מעון״ — בזמן שהאיש מנוקה מעון, המים בודקין את אשתו; אין האיש מנוקה מעון, אין המים בודקין את אשתו, ונמצא שם שמים נמחק לבטלה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:14:1.english: They provide him - The court. One who warned his wife and she secluded herself, and he is bringing her up [to the Temple] to make her drink [the bitter water] — the court of his town provides him with two Torah scholars, lest he engage in intercourse with her on the way; for she has become forbidden to him, as we learned in a mishna (Sotah 27b): “She has been defiled... she has been defiled” — once for the husband and once for the adulterer. If he engages in intercourse with her, the water no longer tests her, as it is written (Numbers 5:31): “And the man shall be clear of iniquity” — when the man is clear of iniquity, the water tests his wife; [if] the man is not clear of iniquity, the water does not test his wife, and [consequently] the Divine Name would turn out to have been erased in vain.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:1:1.hebrew: נקורים - ביקרור"ש בלע"ז, שנקרו תרנגולים בעיסה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:1:1.english: Peck marks - bechedures in Old French, [meaning] that chickens pecked at the dough.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:1:2.hebrew: תולין - אם עיסה זו של תרומה, חיישינן שמא שתו התרנגולין ממשקין הטמאים, ובעוד המשקה טופח בחרטומיהם נקרו בעיסה. ומדקאמר: ״שני דברים הללו עשאום כמי שיש בו דעת לישאל״, ושנינו באחת מהן ״תולין״ — מכלל דתינוק תולין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:1:2.english: [It is] held in suspense - If this dough is of terumah, we are concerned lest the chickens drank from the impure liquids, and while the liquid was [still] moist on their beaks, they pecked at the dough. And from [the fact] that [the baraita] states: “These two things, they treated them like [an entity] that has the capacity to be questioned,” and we learned concerning one of them [that it is] “held in suspense,” it follows that [in the case of] a child, [it is also] held in suspense.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:3:1.hebrew: בריבי - גדול הדור, ריב"ל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:3:1.english: Beribbi - The greatest of the generation, Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:3:2.hebrew: ופירושו לא שמע - דבאדומים נמי היה לו לפרש ולחלק בין צלולים לעכורים — משקין צלולין נוחין ליבלע:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:3:2.english: And he did not hear its explanation - For regarding red [liquids] as well, he should have explained and distinguished between clear and murky [ones] — [as] clear liquids are easily absorbed.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:3:3.english: That the reflection of a child - The likeness of the features of his face.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:4:1.hebrew: עם ב' נשים - מפני שדעתן קלה, ושתיהן נוחות להתפתות, ולא תירא זו מחבירתה, שאף היא תעשה כמותה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:4:1.english: With two women - Because their minds are easily swayed, and both of them are easily seduced, and this one will not fear the other, for she too would do the same.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:4:2.hebrew: עם ב' אנשים - שהאחד בוש מחבירו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:4:2.english: With two men - For one is ashamed before the other.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:4:3.hebrew: מתייחד אדם עם אמו - טעמא מפרש בגמ':
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:4:3.english: A man may be secluded with his mother - The reason is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:4:4.english: [When] they have grown up, this one sleeps in his garment, etc. - And likewise, [the same applies to] a daughter with her father while she is a minor.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:4:5.hebrew: וישן עמהם - הבן עם אמו, ובעודו קטן קאמר דישן עמה בקירוב בשר, כדמפרש ואזיל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:4:5.english: And sleep alongside them - [This refers to] the son with his mother; and [the Mishnah] is saying that he may sleep with her with bodily contact while he is [still] a minor, as it goes on to explain.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:5:1.hebrew: מאי טעמא - לא יתייחד עם שתי נשים, כאשה שמתייחדת עם ב' אנשים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:5:1.english: What is the reason - [Why] may [a man] not be secluded with two women, [just] as a woman is secluded with two men?

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:5:2.english: Their minds are light upon them - And both of them are easily seduced.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:7:1.hebrew: אלא - להכי נקט קרא בן אמך, לומר שהבן מצוי אצל האם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:7:1.english: Rather - For this [reason] Scripture stated “the son of your mother,” to say that a son is frequently found with [his] mother.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:8:1.hebrew: פשטיה דקרא במאי כתיב - לענין פשוטו של מקרא שמדבר בהסתה, אמאי נקט בן אמך:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:8:1.english: With regard to what is the plain [meaning] of the verse written - Regarding the plain [meaning] of the verse, which speaks of enticement [to idolatry], why did [the verse] specify "the son of your mother"?

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:8:2.english: A paternal brother hates him - Because he reduces his share of the inheritance.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:8:3.hebrew: בן אם לא סני ליה - שאין להם חלק ירושה יחד, זה יורש את אביו וזה יורש את אביו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:8:3.english: The son of a mother does not hate him - For they do not have a share of an inheritance together; this one inherits [from] his father, and that one inherits [from] his father.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:9:1.english: Not in accordance with Abba Shaul - For he says that a man may be secluded with two women.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:9:2.hebrew: כל שלשים יום - ולד שמת בתוך שלשים יום, אין צריך לכבדו במותו להוציאו לקבורה לא במטה ולא בכליבה, אלא בחיק:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:9:2.english: All thirty days - [For] an infant who dies within thirty days, one does not need to accord him honor at his death [by] carrying him out for burial, neither on a bier nor in a casket, but rather in [one's] bosom.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:9:3.hebrew: ונקבר באשה אחת ושני אנשים - וא"צ רבים ללוותו, אלא ג':
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:9:3.english: And buried by one woman and two men - And there is no need for many [people] to escort him, but rather [only] three.

Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:9:4.hebrew: אבל לא באיש אחד ושתי נשים - משום יחוד, שלא היו בתי הקברות סמוכין לעיר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 80b:9:4.english: But not by one man and two women - Because of [the prohibition of] seclusion, as cemeteries were not close to the city.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 80b:12:1.hebrew: כי ההיא מעשה דההיא איתתא דהוה עובדא ואפיקתיה - פר"ח: מעשה באשה אחת שהיתה בוכה ומתאוננת על קבר בעלה, והיה שם אדם אחד שהיה שומר תלוי אחד, וצוה לו המלך לשומרו, ובא אצל האשה ופיתה אותה ושמעה לו, וכשחזר אצל התלוי לא מצאו והיה מצטער מאד מפחד המלך. אמרה לו האשה: "אל תירא, קח בעלי מקברו ותלהו במקומו", ואפיקתיה לבעלה ותלהו. הרי לך שאפילו בשעת אנינות נתגבר יצרה עליה. אך הקונטרס פירש ב' לשונות: בלשון אחד גרס: "ורבנן, כי ההיא עובדא דההיא איתתא דהוה עובדא ואפיקתיה", וה"פ: לרבנן, אפילו תביר יצרו כדאמר, יש לחוש דפעמים שאין שם אנינות, ועושין עצמן כאילו נושאין תינוק מת ויוצאין לעבירה, כי ההוא עובדא דההיא אתתא דהוה עובדא ואפיקתיה לתינוק חי בחזקת מת לעשות עבירה עם ההולך עמה לקוברו. ועוד פירש לשון אחר: דלא גרסינן "ורבנן", אלא הכל ממילתיה דאבא שאול, והכי פירושו: כלומר, מה יתרעם אדם על חטאיו, דיו חיים שנתתי לו, כי ההוא מעשה דההיא איתתא — כדאי' בספר חסידים: מעשה באשה אחת שהיו לה ז' בנים, ומת אחד מהם והיתה בוכה, ואמרו לה: "אל תבכי, ואם לאו עוד ימות בן אחר", ולא שתקה ומת אחר, וכן עשתה עד שמתו כולם, והיא אחרי כן, מחמת שנתאוננה על מדותיו. ולהאי פירושא, ל"ג: "דהוה עובדא ואפיקתיה":
Tosafot on Kiddushin 80b:12:1.english: "Like that incident involving a certain woman, as there was an incident where she removed [him]" - Rabbeinu Chananel explained: An incident occurred with a certain woman who was weeping and lamenting over the grave of her husband. And there was a man there who was guarding a hanged [corpse], whom the king had commanded him to guard. And he came to the woman, seduced her, and she listened to him. When he returned to the hanged [corpse], he did not find it, and he was in great distress out of fear of the king. The woman said to him: "Do not fear; take my husband from his grave and hang him in his place." And she brought out her husband and [the guard] hanged him. Here you have [proof] that even during acute mourning (aninut), her [evil] inclination overcame her. However, the Kunteres explained two interpretations: In one interpretation, he read: "And the Rabbis [say]: Like that incident of that woman, where there was an incident and she brought him out." And this is its explanation: According to the Rabbis, even though one's [evil] inclination is broken, as [Abba Shaul] said, there is [still] concern that sometimes there is no acute mourning there, and they make themselves appear as though they are carrying a dead infant and go out to commit a sin, like that incident of that woman, where there was an incident and she brought out a living infant under the presumption of being dead, in order to commit a sin with the one who went with her to bury it. And furthermore, he explained another interpretation: that we do not read "And the Rabbis," but rather the whole [statement] is from the words of Abba Shaul, and this is its explanation: that is to say, why should a person complain about [God's] attributes? "Has he overcome his sins? The life that I gave him is sufficient for him" — like that incident of that woman, as is found in Sefer Chasidim: An incident occurred with a certain woman who had seven sons, and one of them died, and she was weeping. They said to her: "Do not weep, or else another son will die." But she did not fall silent, and another died; and so she did until all of them died, and she [died] after that, because she complained against His attributes. And according to this interpretation, we do not read: "where there was an incident and she brought him out."

Tosafot on Kiddushin 80b:4:1.hebrew: רבי שמעון אומר אף איש אחד מתייחד עם שתי נשים בזמן שאשתו עמו - משמע דלרבנן, אפילו אשתו עמו, אסור להתייחד עם שתי נשים. ואפילו לרבי שמעון נמי — עם שתי נשים ואשתו עמו הוא דשרי, אבל עם אשה אחת, אפילו אשתו עמו אסור. וקשה מההיא דפרק אין מעמידין (ע"ז דף כה.) גבי הא דתנן: "לא תתייחד אשה עמהם", ובעי עלה בגמרא: במאי עסקינן? אילימא בחד — ודכוותה בישראל מי שרי? והתנן: "לא יתייחד..." כו', ומסיק: בשאשתו של עובד כוכבים עמו; עובד כוכבים אין אשתו משמרתו, ישראל אשתו משמרתו. ומדלא מוקי לה התם כרבי שמעון, משמע דאפילו כרבנן נמי אתיא, ובאשה אחת נמי משמע דשרי כשאשתו עמו. לכך נראה לר"י, דלרבי שמעון אינו אסור אלא כשאין אשתו עמו דוקא, והכי גרסינן: "ר' שמעון אומר: אף איש אחד מתייחד עם שתי נשים. ובזמן שאשתו עמו ישן עמהן בפונדקי, מפני שאשתו משמרתו". ואתאן אפילו לרבנן, ואפילו עם אשה אחת:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 80b:4:1.english: "Rabbi Shimon says: Even one man may be secluded with two women when his wife is with him" - This implies that according to the Rabbis, even [when] his wife is with him, it is forbidden [for a man] to be secluded with two women; and even according to Rabbi Shimon as well, it is [only] with two women and [when] his wife is with him that it is permitted, but with one woman, even [when] his wife is with him, it is forbidden. And this is difficult from that [passage] in the chapter [entitled] Ein Ma'amidin (Avodah Zarah 25b) regarding that which we learned [in a mishna]: "A woman may not be secluded with them [gentiles]." And [the Gemara] asks about it: What are we dealing with? If we say with one [gentile] — is the corresponding [case] permitted regarding an Israelite? But didn't we learn: "A man may not be secluded [with two women]..." etc. [which indicates that one man certainly may not be secluded with one woman]! And [the Gemara] concludes: [The mishna is necessary in a case] where the gentile's wife is with him; [for] a gentile, his wife does not guard him, [whereas for] an Israelite, his wife guards him. And since [the Gemara] does not establish that [mishna] there as following [specifically] Rabbi Shimon, this implies that it goes even according to the Rabbis; and it also implies that [seclusion] is permitted even with one woman when his wife is with him. Therefore, it appears to the Ri that according to Rabbi Shimon, [seclusion] is forbidden only when his wife is specifically not with him [and Rabbi Shimon in fact permits seclusion with two women even without his wife]. And this is how we read [the text of the Mishnah]: "Rabbi Shimon says: Even one man may be secluded with two women. And when his wife is with him, he may sleep with them in an inn, because his wife guards him." And [this latter clause] applies even according to the Rabbis, and even with one woman.
